paragraphs.text: The Wolf's Hackle is a land of mountains and swamps of uncertain location in Golthonor , on the Dominarian continent of Corondor .

The exact location of Wolf's Hackle within Golthonor is unknown, but it lies north of the location of former Gan and Ironhold . It was the site of Angel's Keep , Archmage Xarl Angel-Keeper ’s tower, granted to Xarl by Warlord Mandek Ironfist of the Iron Kingdom , where the fallen angel Trine was imprisoned.
